prompt: 请从 safety software V&V 和 functional safety 的角度，给我写一份研究报告。背景是我们在做化工装置 SIS 改造，团队内部对 IEEE 1012、IEC 61508、IEC 61511 的分工总是混淆。请说明这三个标准分别解决什么问题、在 SIS / SIF 生命周期里怎样配合、哪些地方最容易被误解，最后给一个面向工程落地的工作框架。不要直接下合规结论。
assertions: The output includes an Executive Summary
The output distinguishes IEEE 1012 V&V logic from IEC 61508 / IEC 61511 functional safety lifecycle logic
The output explains that SIL applies to a safety function or SIF rather than simply to a single device
The output includes lifecycle workflow, evidence chain, and engineering recommendations
The output avoids claiming formal compliance or certification
